# LeeWay HyperFrames — Editor and Composition Profile

This profile is part of the existing `hyperframes` skill. It is not an application, registry, renderer, Formula implementation, design-system replacement or proof of a deployed editor.

## Integration target

Load `skills/external/impeccable/SKILL.md` for the eight retained design operations and `skills/leeway-creative-rendering-engineering/SKILL.md` for engineering constraints. Then use the pinned/qualified upstream HyperFrames technical contracts required by the task.

Before modifying editor code, establish the Creator-owned canonical application repository, revision, entry point and running-source relationship. Upstream `heygen-com/hyperframes` at `f80614cde4f14654769753198647b32a98ed2a1e` contains `packages/studio/src/App.tsx` and `packages/studio/src/styles/theme.css`; this source location is not authorization to fork, publish or modify that upstream project. No Creator-owned editor checkout was qualified in this curation gate.

## Shared capability handoffs

Treat the following as reusable roles in one LeeWay system, not independent product silos. Bind only real contracts exposed by their canonical owners; names in this table do not establish working adapters.

| Existing capability | Contribution to a creative job | Boundary |
|---|---|---|
| Formula | Evidence-bound policy selection, tradeoffs and working-set decisions where its real domain contract supports them. | Preserve implementation/version/SHA-256, input, decision and execution evidence. No invented media weights, scene encodings or performance claims. |
| Cesium | Spatial/geographic scene, camera, terrain and time-dependent observations appropriate to the composition. | Preserve coordinates, units, time base, source/asset rights and visible attribution. A spatial source is not an unrestricted generative-video model. |
| Continuum | Durable approved project state, design decisions, asset provenance, versions and qualified outcomes. | Reuse its actual storage/approval contract. Do not create a parallel permanent project-memory database. |
| LDWMD | Bounded active edit state, current observations, pending changes and working-set references. | Resolve its actual device-local contract; promote durable state only through authorized existing pathways. Do not rename an arbitrary JSON file LDWMD. |
| LeeWay GPU | Discovered compute/render capability and measured resource constraints. | Availability is not acceleration. Qualify the actual browser/renderer/device route, resource budget and fallback behavior. |
| HyperFrames | Composition structure, seekable timeline, editing, preview and encoding via a qualified provider. | Reuse its renderer rather than replacing it. A prepared project or visible editor is not output proof. |
| Runtime Fabric / Harness / Veritas | Authorization, dispatch, execution, observation and outcome acceptance. | Preserve existing owners, receipts and Learning Ledger; do not add another bus, scheduler or governance engine. |

LTX, Blender, ComfyUI, approved footage and other governed sources may contribute when needed. Do not force every job through LTX or load every capability for every frame. The complete capability field remains eligible; actual execution stays bounded by the task and evidence.

## Editor: Operate

The preview/canvas remains the primary workspace. Make the timeline, asset selection, inspector and Agent Lee controls understandable without duplicating toolbars or hiding authority behind decorative controls. This specifies priorities, not an approved replacement layout.

Maintain one project/timeline source of truth. Selection in canvas, timeline and inspector must refer to the same stable object. Edits must survive save/reopen with a recoverable version or undo path. Present the exact operation state: preparation, authorization, queueing, execution, verification and failure are different.

Provide purposeful grouping, clear type roles, non-color-only status, named icon controls, visible focus, keyboard access and usable touch targets. Surface unavailable capabilities explicitly. Expose useful observed graphs and progress, never synthetic telemetry presented as live. Adapt layout to task, available space and input; don't hardcode a particular phone or drive.

Editor motion may clarify selection and state, but must not delay essential operations. Provide an intentional reduced-motion alternative for editor interactions. Do not silently apply that setting to the exported narrative timeline.

## Composition: authored output

Use approved project tokens, assets, typography, factual text and audio. Keep composition styles isolated from editor chrome. Display-only editor zoom, selection outlines, handles, menus and monitoring panels must not leak into export unless explicitly requested content.

Bind every render to a composition revision, dimensions, frame rate, duration, asset versions and deterministic time source. Derive scene and camera state from that time, not uncontrolled wall-clock animation. Wait for required asset, font and spatial-resource readiness; missing prerequisites must be visible failures or explicit approved fallbacks.

For spatial sequences, define the camera path, coordinate/time conventions and resource readiness contract before capture. Inspect beginning, end, transition and hard-seek frames. Repeated-seek equivalence and cross-host equivalence are separate tests; do not claim pixel-identical output from configuration alone. Preserve data-provider attribution in rendered media where required.

Offline from the Creator's computer is a host/asset-dependency requirement, not a special visual style. Any required executor, authorization service, asset or memory binding must be available on the selected independent device/provider. Merely storing source on GitHub does not demonstrate this path.

## Evidence handoff and acceptance

Reuse the existing Application Adapter lifecycle, browser verification and media-probe capabilities. The selected adapter must expose actual execution and observation, not static capability strings.

Required editor proof: select an item; edit text/property; manipulate the timeline; undo or recover; save/reopen; exercise keyboard/touch controls; verify state labels reflect observed execution.

Required render proof: resolve approved assets; preview; seek to representative frames; render; inspect media properties and extracted frames; confirm edits appear in output and editor chrome does not; test missing-asset and unavailable-provider failure behavior.

For one spatial production proof, trace the real spatial input and time state into a HyperFrames frame and rendered result. Verify memory and Formula interactions separately where invoked. Do not fill unbound services with mock success.

The bundled Impeccable measurement helper can check collected numeric evidence against explicit limits. It cannot collect the evidence, certify accessibility, prove geographic truth or issue Veritas approval. Source/unit tests alone cannot close these live gates.

## Scope of this curation

Implemented here: reusable skill instructions, this shared-capability profile, explicit selective-sync policy, provenance and a tested numeric helper.

Not implemented by this profile: an owned HyperFrames editor fork, CSS deployment, live Cesium/Continuum/LDWMD/Formula/GPU wiring, hosted rendering or a C3 end-to-end receipt. Admit each real connection through existing owners, not by changing these words to PASS.
